verdict.rationale: Docs confirm platforms can pay out to connected accounts, schedule payouts, and check connected-account balances, and one community comment praises Stripe Connect for enabling international marketplace payouts, but the pack contains no explicit documentation of local-currency payout rails, FX conversion mechanics, or settlement to local bank rails versus wires. An older community complaint even flags lack of international support as a pain point. missing for 10: dedicated docs on multi-currency payouts, FX conversion/fee transparency, and local bank-rail settlement for connected accounts.
